entries.name: Poha
entries.description: Flattened rice cooked with onions, peanuts, mustard seeds, and turmeric.

entries.name: Kanda Poha
entries.description: Poha loaded with extra onions and garnished with fresh coriander and sev.

entries.name: Upma
entries.description: Semolina (rava) cooked with vegetables, curry leaves, and urad dal.

entries.name: Idli
entries.description: Soft, fluffy steamed cakes made from fermented rice and lentil batter.

entries.name: Masala Dosa
entries.description: Thin, crispy crepe made from fermented batter, stuffed with spiced potato filling.

entries.name: Neer Dosa
entries.description: Lacy, soft, and thin crepes made from unfermented rice batter.

entries.name: Appam
entries.description: Bowl-shaped thin pancakes made from fermented rice batter and coconut milk.

entries.name: Puttu
entries.description: Cylindrical steamed rice flour layered with grated coconut.

entries.name: Aloo Paratha
entries.description: Whole wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced mashed potatoes, roasted with ghee.

entries.name: Gobi Paratha
entries.description: Flatbread stuffed with spiced grated cauliflower.

entries.name: Paneer Paratha
entries.description: Flatbread stuffed with spiced grated cottage cheese.

entries.name: Chole Bhature
entries.description: Spicy chickpea curry served with deep-fried fluffy bread.

entries.name: Puri Sabzi
entries.description: Deep-fried wheat bread served with a spiced potato curry.

entries.name: Amaranth Bhaji
entries.description: Leafy amaranth greens cooked as a simple Maharashtrian bhaji.

entries.name: Misal Pav
entries.description: Spicy moth bean curry topped with farsan, served with soft bread rolls (pav).

entries.name: Dhokla
entries.description: Spongy, savory cake made from fermented gram flour batter, tempered with mustard seeds.

entries.name: Thepla
entries.description: Spiced flatbread made from whole wheat flour, gram flour, and fresh fenugreek leaves.

entries.name: Fafda Jalebi
entries.description: Crunchy besan snack (fafda) paired with sweet, syrupy jalebis.

entries.name: Khandvi
entries.description: Tightly rolled bite-sized savory snack made from gram flour and yogurt.

entries.name: Luchi Alu Dum
entries.description: Deep-fried refined flour bread served with slowly cooked spicy potatoes.

entries.name: Pesarattu
entries.description: Crepe made from green gram batter, often filled with upma.

entries.name: Ven Pongal
entries.description: Savory porridge made of rice and moong dal, heavily tempered with black pepper, cumin, and ghee.

entries.name: Sabudana Khichdi
entries.description: Tapioca pearls cooked with roasted peanuts, potatoes, and mild spices.

entries.name: Besan Chilla
entries.description: Savory pancake made from gram flour, veggies, and spices.

entries.name: Moong Dal Chilla
entries.description: Protein-rich savory pancake made from soaked and ground yellow moong dal.

entries.name: Boiled Egg
entries.description: Simple hard or soft boiled eggs, often sprinkled with salt and pepper.

entries.name: Egg Omelette
entries.description: Beaten eggs cooked in a pan, often with chopped onions, green chilies, and coriander.

entries.name: Masala Omelette
entries.description: Spicy Indian style omelette loaded with turmeric, chili powder, onions, and tomatoes.

entries.name: Half Fry (Sunny Side Up)
entries.description: Egg fried on one side, leaving the yolk runny.

entries.name: Egg Bhurji
entries.description: Indian-style scrambled eggs cooked with a heavy tempering of onions, tomatoes, and spices.

entries.name: Boil Egg Bhurji
entries.description: Mashed boiled eggs sautéed with onions, tomatoes, and Indian masalas.

entries.name: Egg Boil Fry
entries.description: Halved boiled eggs shallow fried with a coating of spicy masala.

entries.name: Egg Sandwich
entries.description: Sliced boiled eggs or omelette stuffed between bread slices with mayo or chutney.

entries.name: French Toast (Sweet/Savory)
entries.description: Bread slices dipped in a beaten egg mixture and pan-fried. Indian versions are often savory and spicy.

entries.name: Bread Butter
entries.description: Slices of white or brown bread smeared with butter.

entries.name: Toast Jam
entries.description: Toasted bread spread with fruit jam or marmalade.

entries.name: Oats/Porridge
entries.description: Rolled oats cooked in milk or water, topped with fruits and nuts.

entries.name: Cornflakes with Milk
entries.description: Ready-to-eat cereal flakes served with hot or cold milk.

entries.name: Muesli
entries.description: Mix of oats, nuts, seeds, and dried fruits served with milk or yogurt.

entries.name: Pancakes
entries.description: Flat sweet cakes served with honey or maple syrup.

entries.name: Roti/Phulka
entries.description: Thin, unleavened whole wheat bread cooked on a tawa and puffed over an open flame.

entries.name: Chapati
entries.description: Slightly thicker whole wheat flatbread cooked on a tawa.

entries.name: Plain Naan
entries.description: Leavened flatbread made from refined flour, baked in a tandoor.

entries.name: Butter Naan
entries.description: Naan brushed generously with butter after baking.

entries.name: Garlic Naan
entries.description: Naan topped with minced garlic and coriander before baking.

entries.name: Tandoori Roti
entries.description: Whole wheat bread baked in a cylindrical clay oven.

entries.name: Missi Roti
entries.description: Savory flatbread made from a mix of whole wheat flour and gram flour (besan) with spices.

entries.name: Makki ki Roti
entries.description: Rustic flatbread made from cornmeal, typically paired with Sarson ka Saag.

entries.name: Bajra Bhakri
entries.description: Thick, rustic flatbread made from pearl millet flour.

entries.name: Jowar Bhakri
entries.description: Gluten-free flatbread made from sorghum flour.

entries.name: Rumali Roti
entries.description: Extremely thin, handkerchief-like bread cooked on a convex griddle.

entries.name: Parotta
entries.description: Flaky, layered flatbread made from refined flour.

entries.name: Steamed Rice
entries.description: Plain white basmati or short-grain rice.

entries.name: Jeera Rice
entries.description: Basmati rice flavored with cumin seeds and whole spices.

entries.name: Veg Pulao
entries.description: One-pot rice dish cooked with mixed vegetables and mild spices.

entries.name: Peas Pulao
entries.description: Rice cooked with sweet green peas and whole garam masala.

entries.name: Veg Biryani
entries.description: Aromatic layered rice and vegetable dish cooked with rich spices and herbs.

entries.name: Chicken Biryani
entries.description: Classic layered dish of basmati rice and marinated chicken cooked slowly.

entries.name: Mutton Biryani
entries.description: Rich, deeply flavored biryani made with tender goat meat.

entries.name: Egg Biryani
entries.description: Spiced layered rice dish featuring boiled eggs.

entries.name: Hyderabadi Biryani
entries.description: Spicy, aromatic biryani famous for its raw meat slow-cooking technique (Kacchi Dum).

entries.name: Kolkata Biryani
entries.description: Subtly spiced biryani characterized by the inclusion of soft potatoes and boiled eggs.

entries.name: Lucknowi Biryani
entries.description: Mildly spiced, fragrant biryani cooked in a rich stock (Pukki style).

entries.name: Lemon Rice
entries.description: Cooked rice tempered with mustard, curry leaves, peanuts, and freshly squeezed lemon juice.

entries.name: Tamarind Rice
entries.description: Tangy and spicy rice dish flavored with tamarind paste and peanuts (Puliyogare).

entries.name: Curd Rice
entries.description: Comforting mix of soft-cooked rice and yogurt, tempered with mustard and curry leaves.

entries.name: Khichdi
entries.description: Comforting, mushy one-pot meal of rice and lentils cooked together with mild turmeric.

entries.name: Bisi Bele Bath
entries.description: Spicy, tangy meal of rice, lentils, and vegetables cooked together with a special spice blend.

entries.name: Dal Tadka
entries.description: Yellow lentils cooked and finished with a sizzling tempering of ghee, cumin, garlic, and chilies.

entries.name: Dal Makhani
entries.description: Rich, creamy slow-cooked black lentils and kidney beans prepared with butter and cream.

entries.name: Chana Dal
entries.description: Split chickpeas cooked with onions, tomatoes, and spices.

entries.name: Sambhar
entries.description: Tangy lentil and vegetable stew flavored with tamarind and a special spice powder.

entries.name: Rasam
entries.description: Thin, spicy, and tangy soup-like dish made with tamarind, tomatoes, black pepper, and cumin.

entries.name: Rajma Masala
entries.description: Red kidney beans cooked in a thick, flavorful onion-tomato gravy.

entries.name: Pindi Chole
entries.description: Dark, spicy, and tangy chickpea curry flavored with tea leaves and amla.

entries.name: Kadhi Pakora
entries.description: Tangy yogurt and gram flour curry featuring deep-fried onion/besan fritters.

entries.name: Aloo Gobi
entries.description: Classic dry curry made with potatoes and cauliflower florets with Indian spices.

entries.name: Jeera Aloo
entries.description: Simple boiled potatoes sautéed heavily with cumin seeds and green chilies.

entries.name: Dum Aloo
entries.description: Baby potatoes deep-fried and slow-cooked in a rich, spiced yogurt or tomato gravy.

entries.name: Bhindi Masala
entries.description: Okra stir-fried with onions, tomatoes, and tangy spices.

entries.name: Baingan Bharta
entries.description: Fire-roasted eggplant mashed and cooked with mustard oil, onions, tomatoes, and garlic.

entries.name: Malai Kofta
entries.description: Deep-fried potato and paneer dumplings served in a rich, creamy, sweet-savory gravy.

entries.name: Mix Veg Curry
entries.description: Assorted vegetables cooked together in an onion-tomato gravy.

entries.name: Paneer Butter Masala
entries.description: Cottage cheese cubes in a rich, creamy, mildly sweet tomato and butter gravy.

entries.name: Kadai Paneer
entries.description: Paneer cooked with bell peppers, onions, and freshly ground kadai masala.

entries.name: Palak Paneer
entries.description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a smooth, spiced spinach puree.

entries.name: Matar Paneer
entries.description: Paneer and green peas cooked in a traditional tomato-based gravy.

entries.name: Gatte Ki Sabzi
entries.description: Gram flour dumplings cooked in a spicy, tangy yogurt gravy.

entries.name: Undhiyu
entries.description: Traditional mixed vegetable dish cooked slowly, often with muthiyas (fenugreek dumplings).

entries.name: Avial
entries.description: Thick mixture of assorted vegetables, coconut, and yogurt, seasoned with coconut oil and curry leaves.

entries.name: Cabbage Thoran
entries.description: Finely chopped cabbage stir-fried with grated coconut, mustard seeds, and curry leaves.

entries.name: Shukto
entries.description: A mildly bitter, mixed vegetable stew typically served at the beginning of a Bengali meal.

entries.name: Butter Chicken
entries.description: Tandoori chicken pieces simmered in a rich, creamy tomato and butter gravy.

entries.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
entries.description: Roasted marinated chicken chunks in a spiced, creamy orange-colored curry.

entries.name: Kadai Chicken
entries.description: Spicy chicken cooked with bell peppers and freshly ground spices in a wok (kadai).

entries.name: Home Style Chicken Curry
entries.description: Thin, flavorful chicken curry made with onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and whole spices.

entries.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
entries.description: Aromatic lamb/mutton curry cooked with Kashmiri chilies, fennel, and ginger.

entries.name: Kosha Mangsho
entries.description: Spicy, slow-cooked Bengali mutton curry with a dark, thick, intensely flavorful gravy.

entries.name: Laal Maas
entries.description: Fiery Rajasthani mutton curry cooked with heavily spiced red mathania chilies and garlic.

entries.name: Chettinad Chicken
entries.description: Highly spiced and aromatic chicken curry from the Chettinad region, using roasted coconut and spices.

entries.name: Goan Fish Curry
entries.description: Tangy and spicy fish curry made with coconut base and kokum or tamarind.

entries.name: Macher Jhol
entries.description: Traditional Bengali fish stew cooked with potatoes, mustard oil, and light spices.

entries.name: Fish Fry
entries.description: Fish slices or whole fish marinated in fiery spices and fried till crisp.

entries.name: Prawn Masala
entries.description: Succulent prawns cooked in a thick, spicy onion-tomato masala base.

entries.name: Egg Curry
entries.description: Boiled and lightly fried eggs simmered in a spiced tomato-onion gravy.

entries.name: Samosa
entries.description: Triangular pastry filled with spiced potatoes and peas.

entries.name: Kachori
entries.description: Round, flaky pastry filled with a spiced lentil or onion mixture.

entries.name: Onion Pakora/Bhajiya
entries.description: Sliced onions coated in seasoned gram flour batter and deep-fried till crispy.

entries.name: Paneer Pakora
entries.description: Cottage cheese slices dipped in besan batter and fried.

entries.name: Vada Pav
entries.description: Spicy potato fritter stuffed in a bun (pav) with dry garlic and green chutneys.

entries.name: Dabeli
entries.description: Sweet and spicy potato mixture stuffed in a bun, topped with pomegranate, peanuts, and sev.

entries.name: Pani Puri / Golgappa / Puchka
entries.description: Hollow, crispy puris filled with flavored spicy water, tamarind chutney, and potato/chickpea mash.

entries.name: Bhel Puri
entries.description: Puffed rice mixed with sev, chopped onions, potatoes, and sweet/tangy/spicy chutneys.

entries.name: Sev Puri
entries.description: Flat crispy puris topped with diced potatoes, onions, three chutneys, and copious amounts of sev.

entries.name: Aloo Tikki Chaat
entries.description: Crispy potato patties smashed and topped with yogurt, chutneys, spices, and sev.

entries.name: Samosa Chaat
entries.description: Crushed samosas topped with chole (chickpea curry), yogurt, and chutneys.

entries.name: Kathi Roll
entries.description: Skewer-roasted kebab (chicken/paneer) wrapped in a paratha flatbread.

entries.name: Egg Roll
entries.description: Paratha layered with a beaten egg, cooked, and filled with onions, sauces, and spices.

entries.name: Chicken Roll
entries.description: Paratha or wrap filled with spicy chicken chunks, onions, and sauces.

entries.name: Veg Hakka Noodles
entries.description: Boiled noodles tossed with shredded cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, soy sauce, and vinegar.

entries.name: Chicken Hakka Noodles
entries.description: Noodles stir-fried with chicken strips, veggies, and Chinese sauces.

entries.name: Schezwan Fried Rice
entries.description: Spicy fried rice tossed in a fiery red Schezwan pepper sauce.

entries.name: Gobi Manchurian
entries.description: Crispy fried cauliflower florets tossed in a dark, soy-based sweet and spicy sauce.

entries.name: Paneer Chilli
entries.description: Fried paneer cubes tossed with diced onions, bell peppers, green chilies, and soy sauce.

entries.name: Chicken Chilli
entries.description: Batter-fried chicken pieces tossed in a spicy, garlicky soy sauce with peppers.

entries.name: Veg Momos
entries.description: Dumplings stuffed with finely chopped cabbage, carrots, and onions, served with spicy red chutney.

entries.name: Chicken Momos
entries.description: Dumplings filled with minced seasoned chicken.

entries.name: Spring Roll
entries.description: Thin pastry wrappers filled with julienned vegetables/chicken and fried till crisp.

entries.name: Margherita Pizza
entries.description: Classic pizza topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, and basil.

entries.name: Veggie Supreme Pizza
entries.description: Pizza loaded with onions, bell peppers, mushrooms, corn, and olives.

entries.name: Paneer Tikka Pizza
entries.description: Pizza topped with tandoori paneer cubes, onions, and capsicum.

entries.name: Chicken Tikka Pizza
entries.description: Pizza topped with spicy marinated chicken chunks.

entries.name: Red Sauce Pasta (Arrabbiata)
entries.description: Penne or macaroni cooked in a tangy, spicy tomato and garlic sauce.

entries.name: White Sauce Pasta (Alfredo)
entries.description: Pasta cooked in a creamy, cheesy bechamel sauce with garlic and herbs.

entries.name: Mac & Cheese
entries.description: Macaroni pasta cooked in a rich, gooey cheddar cheese sauce.

entries.name: Veg Burger
entries.description: Burger bun filled with a mixed vegetable patty, lettuce, tomato, and mayo.

entries.name: Aloo Tikki Burger
entries.description: Indian-style burger featuring a crispy, spiced potato patty.

entries.name: Chicken Burger
entries.description: Burger featuring a fried or grilled chicken patty.

entries.name: French Fries
entries.description: Classic salted, deep-fried potato batons.

entries.name: Peri Peri Fries
entries.description: French fries tossed in a spicy, tangy African-style peri peri seasoning.

entries.name: Potato Wedges
entries.description: Thick-cut, seasoned potato wedges, often served with sour cream or mayo.

entries.name: Bombay Veg Sandwich
entries.description: Slices of bread layered with butter, green chutney, and thin slices of cucumber, tomato, onion, and boiled potato.

entries.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
entries.description: Bread slices stuffed with cheese and grilled until golden and melting.

entries.name: Chicken Mayo Sandwich
entries.description: Sandwich filled with a mixture of shredded boiled chicken, mayonnaise, and black pepper.

entries.name: Veg Puff
entries.description: Flaky puff pastry stuffed with a mildly spiced mixed vegetable or potato filling.

entries.name: Egg Puff
entries.description: Puff pastry enclosing half a boiled egg wrapped in a spicy onion masala.

entries.name: Chicken Puff
entries.description: Puff pastry stuffed with minced or shredded spicy chicken.

entries.name: Khari Biscuit
entries.description: Light, airy, flaky, and salty puff pastry biscuits, often dipped in tea.

entries.name: Rusk / Toast
entries.description: Twice-baked, hard, and crisp bread, commonly eaten with chai.

entries.name: Shrewsbury Biscuit
entries.description: Rich, buttery, melt-in-mouth sweet biscuits famous in Pune bakeries.

entries.name: Nankhatai
entries.description: Traditional Indian shortbread cookies made from all-purpose flour, besan, and ghee.

entries.name: Plum Cake
entries.description: Dense cake loaded with dry fruits and nuts, especially popular around Christmas.

entries.name: Black Forest Cake
entries.description: Chocolate sponge cake layered with whipped cream and cherries.

entries.name: Pineapple Pastry
entries.description: Soft vanilla sponge layered with whipped cream and chopped pineapple pieces.

entries.name: Gulab Jamun
entries.description: Deep-fried dough balls made of milk solids (khoya) soaked in a fragrant sugar syrup.

entries.name: Rasgulla
entries.description: Spongy, white dumplings made of chhena (cottage cheese) cooked in light sugar syrup.

entries.name: Rasmalai
entries.description: Flattened chhena discs soaked in a rich, saffron and cardamom flavored sweetened milk.

entries.name: Rice Kheer / Payasam
entries.description: Creamy pudding made by slowly boiling rice, milk, and sugar, garnished with nuts.

entries.name: Gajar Ka Halwa
entries.description: Rich dessert made from grated carrots slow-cooked in milk, ghee, and sugar.

entries.name: Moong Dal Halwa
entries.description: Dense, ghee-rich sweet dish made from yellow split moong dal.

entries.name: Sooji Halwa
entries.description: Semolina roasted in ghee and cooked with water/milk and sugar (also known as Sheera).

entries.name: Kaju Katli
entries.description: Diamond-shaped, fudgy sweet made purely from cashew nuts, sugar, and ghee.

entries.name: Besan Ladoo
entries.description: Round sweet balls made from roasted gram flour, powdered sugar, and ghee.

entries.name: Motichoor Ladoo
entries.description: Soft laddos made from tiny, fine droplets of deep-fried besan mixed in sugar syrup.

entries.name: Jalebi
entries.description: Spiral-shaped, crispy, deep-fried batter soaked in saffron sugar syrup.

entries.name: Imarti
entries.description: Similar to Jalebi but made from urad dal batter, featuring a more intricate floral shape.

entries.name: Ghevar
entries.description: Disc-shaped sweet with a honeycomb-like texture, popular during monsoon festivals (Teej/Rakhi).

entries.name: Ukadiche Modak
entries.description: Steamed rice-flour dumplings stuffed with a sweet mixture of freshly grated coconut and jaggery. (Ganesh Chaturthi special)

entries.name: Fried Modak
entries.description: Wheat or refined flour outer covering, stuffed with coconut-jaggery and deep-fried.

entries.name: Gujiya / Karanji
entries.description: Crescent-shaped, deep-fried pastry stuffed with sweet khoya, coconut, and dry fruits. (Holi/Diwali special)

entries.name: Puran Poli
entries.description: Sweet flatbread stuffed with a smooth, cooked mixture of chana dal, jaggery, and cardamom. (Holi/Gudi Padwa special)

entries.name: Shrikhand
entries.description: Thick, creamy, and sweet dessert made from strained yogurt, flavored with saffron and cardamom.

entries.name: Mishti Doi
entries.description: Classic Bengali dessert made by fermenting thick milk mixed with caramelized sugar/jaggery.

entries.name: Mysore Pak
entries.description: Rich, crumbly, and melt-in-mouth sweet block made generously with ghee, besan, and sugar.

entries.name: Qubani Ka Meetha
entries.description: Hyderabadi dessert made from dried apricots stewed to a jam-like consistency, served with cream/ice cream.

entries.name: Phirni
entries.description: Thick, creamy dessert made from coarsely ground rice, set in earthen pots.

entries.name: Kulfi
entries.description: Traditional Indian ice cream, denser and creamier than Western ice creams, flavored with malai, pista, or mango.

entries.name: Falooda
entries.description: Rich layered dessert drink containing rose syrup, vermicelli, sweet basil seeds (sabja), milk, and topped with ice cream.

entries.name: Mint Coriander Chutney
entries.description: Spicy, tangy green chutney made from fresh mint, coriander, green chilies, and lemon juice.

entries.name: Tamarind Date Chutney (Meethi)
entries.description: Sweet and sour dark brown chutney essential for chaats, made from tamarind, jaggery, and dates.

entries.name: Coconut Chutney
entries.description: White chutney made from grated coconut, roasted chana dal, and green chilies, tempered with mustard leaves.

entries.name: Tomato Chutney
entries.description: Tangy and slightly spicy red chutney made by cooking tomatoes with onions and red chilies.

entries.name: Peanut Chutney
entries.description: Thick, earthy chutney made from roasted peanuts, garlic, and chilies.

entries.name: Garlic Chutney (Lehsan)
entries.description: Fiery red chutney made from fresh garlic cloves, red chili powder, and oil.

entries.name: Mango Pickle (Aam Ka Achar)
entries.description: Raw green mangoes cured in mustard oil, salt, and strong pickling spices like fenugreek and fennel.

entries.name: Lime Pickle (Nimbu Ka Achar)
entries.description: Lemons preserved in a sweet or spicy mix, heavily salted to soften the rind over time.

entries.name: Mixed Veg Pickle
entries.description: Carrots, cauliflower, green chilies, and sometimes turnips pickled in oil and spices.

entries.name: Green Chilli Pickle
entries.description: Slit green chilies stuffed or coated with mustard seeds, salt, and oil.

entries.name: Boondi Raita
entries.description: Whisked yogurt mixed with tiny, crisp deep-fried besan balls (boondi), seasoned with roasted cumin powder.

entries.name: Cucumber Raita
entries.description: Cooling side dish of yogurt mixed with grated or finely chopped cucumber.

entries.name: Mix Veg Raita
entries.description: Yogurt blended with finely chopped onions, tomatoes, and cucumbers.

entries.name: Papad (Roasted/Fried)
entries.description: Thin, crisp disc-shaped food made from lentil, chickpea, or rice flour.

entries.name: Masala Papad
entries.description: Fried or roasted papad generously topped with chopped onions, tomatoes, coriander, and chaat masala.

entries.name: Kachumber Salad
entries.description: Simple fresh salad of chopped onions, tomatoes, cucumbers, tossed with lemon juice and salt.

entries.name: Tomato Ketchup
entries.description: Sweet and tangy tomato sauce, eaten with snacks and fast food.

entries.name: Green Chilli Sauce
entries.description: Spicy sauce made from pureed green chilies and vinegar.

entries.name: Soy Sauce
entries.description: Dark, salty liquid condiment used heavily in Desi Chinese preparations.

entries.name: Vinegar (Sirka)
entries.description: Sour acidic liquid. Often used to soak onions (Sirke wale Pyaaz) in North Indian restaurants.

entries.name: Schezwan Chutney
entries.description: Fiery red, garlicky sauce packed with dried red chilies and Sichuan peppercorns.

entries.name: Mayonnaise
entries.description: Thick, creamy sauce used in sandwiches, burgers, and rolls.

entries.name: Mint Mayo
entries.description: Mayonnaise blended with mint and coriander chutney, popular with tandoori snacks.

entries.name: Kasundi (Mustard)
entries.description: Pungent, highly flavored Bengali mustard sauce, excellent with fried fish or chops.

entries.name: Masala Chai
entries.description: Indian tea brewed with milk, sugar, and warming spices like cardamom, ginger, cloves, and black pepper.

entries.name: Adrak Chai (Ginger Tea)
entries.description: Tea brewed robustly with fresh grated ginger.

entries.name: Filter Coffee
entries.description: Strong, frothy coffee made by mixing frothed and boiled milk with the decoction obtained by brewing finely ground coffee powder in a traditional Indian filter.

entries.name: Instant Coffee
entries.description: Quick coffee made by mixing instant coffee powder, hot milk, and sugar.

entries.name: Kashmiri Kahwa
entries.description: Traditional green tea preparation infused with saffron, cinnamon, cardamom, and almond slivers.

entries.name: Haldi Doodh (Turmeric Milk)
entries.description: Warm milk mixed with turmeric powder and sometimes black pepper, known for immunity.

entries.name: Hot Chocolate
entries.description: Rich beverage made from cocoa powder, hot milk, and sugar.

entries.name: Sweet Lassi
entries.description: Thick, creamy, yogurt-based sweet drink, often flavored with cardamom or rose water.

entries.name: Mango Lassi
entries.description: Sweet lassi blended with fresh mango pulp.

entries.name: Chaas (Buttermilk)
entries.description: Thin, savory yogurt-based drink, often spiced with roasted cumin, green chilies, and salt. Extremely cooling.

entries.name: Thandai
entries.description: Cold milk beverage prepared with a mixture of almonds, fennel seeds, watermelon kernels, rose petals, pepper, vetiver, cardamom, and saffron. (Holi/Maha Shivaratri special)

entries.name: Rooh Afza (Rose Milk/Water)
entries.description: Cooling drink made by mixing a concentrated sweet herbal/rose syrup with water or milk.

entries.name: Shikanji (Nimbu Pani)
entries.description: Indian-style spiced lemonade made with cold water, lemon juice, sugar, black salt, and roasted cumin powder.

entries.name: Jaljeera
entries.description: Tangy, spicy, and refreshing drink made with water and a special spice mix featuring cumin, mint, and black salt.

entries.name: Aam Panna
entries.description: Tangy summer cooler made from boiled raw green mangoes, sugar/jaggery, mint, and cumin.

entries.name: Sol Kadhi
entries.description: Pink-colored savory, tangy digestive drink made from kokum juice and fresh coconut milk.

entries.name: Sugarcane Juice (Ganne ka Ras)
entries.description: Freshly pressed juice from sugarcane, often flavored with a hint of ginger, lemon, and mint.

entries.name: Sweet Lime Juice (Mosambi)
entries.description: Fresh citrus juice, mildly sweet and sour, often served with a dash of black salt/chaat masala.

entries.name: Tender Coconut Water
entries.description: Natural, refreshing clear water inside young, green coconuts.

entries.name: Cold Coffee
entries.description: Thick, frothy, cold blended drink made with milk, instant coffee, sugar, and ice.

entries.name: Milkshakes (Mango, Chikoo, Chocolate)
entries.description: Sweet, cold beverage made by blending milk, ice cream, and fruit/syrup flavors.

entries.name: Sodas (Cola, Limca, Thums Up)
entries.description: Ready-to-drink fizzy, sweetened carbonated beverages.
